RS1195-h1.note: Part of a farm near Pistoia. After Monna Stefana's death it remains to Simone di Ricciardo Baroncelli or his heirs (deed ser Lapo Mazzei / ser Daccio). Measurement and valuation sent by Donato d'Agnolo Ambruogi 31 July 1389: 6 pieces towards the bridge (st. 17 pan. 7 pu. 6, ℔ 1277 ß 16 𝒹 3), 5 pieces next to these (st. 17 pan. 4 pu. 8, ℔ 1021 ß 11 𝒹 4), 4 pieces towards Prato (st. 14 pan. 10 pu. 6, ℔ 762 ß 6 𝒹 11); total ℔ 3061 ß 14 𝒹 6 = ƒ 811 ß 4; reported to ser Niccolao in Pistoia. On 18 Oct 1390 the officials of the Monte gave the farm to Andrea di messer Ugo for the dowry of Niccolosa di Giovanni Baroncelli, wife of his son Ugo. Rent reading 'v mine ottanta' (after deleted 'xx') unclear.
